newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P says cuts Ashikaga Bank's long-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P says cuts Ashikaga Bank's long-term ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Monday that it had lowered its long-term counterparty and certificates of deposit (CD) ratings of Ashikaga Bank Ltd to BBB- from BBB.
S&P said in a statement that it had affirmed Ashikaga's short-term counterparty and CD ratings at A3.
The outlook for the ratings remained negative, S&P said.
Ashikaga's loan losses could grow as collateral values remain under stress, S&P said.
It added that the bank's financial parameters would be pressured until its asset-quality problems become more controllable.
Ashikaga's response to the challenges posed by financial deregulation would likely be delayed if its asset-quality problems take more time to resolve than those of its peers, S&P said.
